large white tactical/command truck parked across roadway

verdict.summary: Heavy police activity blocking residential intersection, expect closures and delays.
verdict.details: Aerial view of residential intersection near church with heavy police presence. Multiple marked police SUVs and a large white tactical vehicle block the roadway. Traffic queued on both streets. Several officers and bystanders standing near vehicles. Houses and trees surround scene. No fire or ambulance visible.
